what: The lint registry and the feature gates are rustc 1.99.0s, copied by hand, and the pin moved to 1.101.0-nightly on 2026-10-25 with no check that they still match: nine lints of the pinned rustc were unknown names (`#[allow(aligned_fields_in_packed)]` was `unknown_lints`, an error under `#![deny(warnings)]`), two removed lints were still lints, `c_variadic_naked_functions` was still gated, and `counts_are_rustcs` was already failing on main for another reason, so it could not have caught any of it.
cost: found by reading rustc_lint_defs at the pinned commit by hand, about two hours with the fixes
cause: class: a check outside the gate rots silently. The table is a hand copy of `declare_lint!` with no generator (checks/features/attributes/table.py is one for the attribute table) and the daily bump has no step that diffs it
workaround: a throwaway script that parses `declare_lint!` of a sparse checkout of rust-lang/rust at library/UPSTREAMs commit and diffs name, level, text and flags against lints.rs; three nightly-only differences are left (linker_info and linker_messages crate-level, rust_2021_prefixes_incompatible_syntax a semantics change, semicolon_in_expressions_from_non_local_macros not in the dependency report), each with new wording in rustc that blaze-diagnostics does not have
state: open: generate lints.rs from the pinned rustcs source as table.py does, and run the generator in the bump
